culture.text: Staff mostly come from Erasmus University, Tilburg and Utrecht, with backgrounds in marketing, economics, psychology and econometrics.
New starters rotate through all parts of research projects and are expected to become experts in conjoint methodology.
It describes a close, fun team culture with an annual SKIMday celebration for all staff.

open.text: SKIM Analytical is an IND recognised sponsor, and both current openings mention visas.
In 2024 it had 300+ staff across 11 offices, representing more than 40 nationalities and 60% female.

growth.text: Started in 1979 in the founder's attic, it now has 13 offices worldwide, each started by staff who moved abroad.
